metaTitle: Custom Wheat Straw Headphones | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order eco-friendly custom wheat straw headphones for your brand. Sustainable, durable, and perfect for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Wheat straw headphones offer a sustainable alternative to traditional plastic headsets, using agricultural byproducts to create a durable, textured finish. These eco-friendly headphones are ideal for trade shows, corporate gifts, or employee wellness kits where environmental values matter. The natural flecks in the material give each unit a unique look, while maintaining the sound quality and comfort expected from standard headphones. Customize with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving for a subtle, professional brand impression.
heroAltText: Custom wheat straw headphones with eco-friendly textured finish and logo imprint on ear cups
